ns2:course.label: Leadership Laboratory
ns2:course.description: (AFAS 102) Aerospace Studies Leadership Laboratory (LLAB) is a co-requisite with all Air Force Aerospace Studies courses. LLAB is the application of personal leadership skills, demonstration of command, effective communication, individual leadership instruction, physical fitness training, and knowledge of U. S. Air Force customs and courtesies. May be repeated. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
